sources.verified_fact: The API returns valid crime-category identifiers for a requested data-set month.
sources.quality_effect: Prevents invalid or silently changed category identifiers from being accepted.

sources.verified_fact: The force-list method supplies force IDs but excludes British Transport Police from the returned list.
sources.quality_effect: BTP must not be treated as a missing force merely because it is absent from this endpoint.

sources.verified_fact: Street-level outcomes can be queried by location, point or polygon; outcomes are unavailable for the Police Service of Northern Ireland.
sources.quality_effect: Outcome coverage limits are recorded instead of inferred as zero.

sources.verified_fact: The availability method lists months with street-crime data and the forces supplying stop-and-search data for each month.
sources.quality_effect: Month availability can be checked before endpoint execution.

sources.source: Home Office police recorded crime and outcomes open data
sources.verified_fact: The official data-set page was last updated 23 April 2026 and provides Police Force Area, Community Safety Partnership and outcomes tables, including year-ending-March-2026 outcomes data.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an official aggregate cross-check source separate from street-level API results.

sources.source: ONS Police Force Area data tables
sources.verified_fact: The current Police Force Area data tables were released 23 April 2026; the next release is scheduled for 23 July 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Provides area-level trend validation but is not parcel-level evidence.
